snippet.title: Super Granny (PC 2004) - Full Game 1080p60 HD Playthrough - No Commentary
snippet.description:
Includes all 100 levels (Arcade Mode) and the credits.

If you enjoyed watching this video, please leave a like and subscribe! I would very much appreciate it!

This playthrough is far from perfect, which is why I'm not calling it a walkthrough. The highscore unfortunately resets after you close the game, which is why my score will be 0 again in the next video. I played this many years ago as a kid, so I'm thrilled to have this on my channel. 

Super Granny (PC) playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLYwqV0N4djf9M5ZkBSYLcQWLnmQC4eKyq

Summary: Welcome to Super Granny!™  Help Granny save her cats scattered throughout the land. Use your wits and your reflexes to climb, dig, float and jackhammer the way to your precious kitties. Along the way you'll discover that it's more than your cats that you are saving. There's much more to Super Granny than meets the eye!

Release Date - June 30, 2004
Genre - Arcade, Action, Puzzle, Adventure
Platforms - Windows
Developer - Sandlot Games
Publisher - WildTangent

My Xbox gamertag: TGG Yari
My PlayStation gamertag: ToughGamingGuyYT
My Steam gamertag: ToughGamingGuy

Wanna see more of my fantastic walkthroughs? Give it a go: https://www.youtube.com/user/ToughGamingGuy/playlists
